compiled_state.title: Complete manual step: External heartbeat monitor (status badge / scheduled-canary action / other)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Configure and verify an external "no-run-in-N-hours" heartbeat alert that monitors the reconcile-bridge.yml workflow independently from the reconciler itself.
**Why**: The reconciler cannot alert on its own failure (it is not running). An out-of-band heartbeat is the only mechanism that catches the reconciler silently stopping — a critical operational reliability requirement.
**Scope**:
- IN: Choose and configure a heartbeat service (status badge monitor, scheduled-canary GitHub Action, or other); verify it fires within configured window when the workflow is simulated-disabled
- OUT: The reconcile-bridge.yml workflow itself; any changes to the reconciler code

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, an external heartbeat monitor is configured, and a simulated workflow disable triggers a heartbeat alert within the configured window (manual verification)
  ← Satisfies: sc-7 (sc-7: "Rollback dry-run: pre-cutover playbook executes cleanly on a throwaway branch; old bridges run a single scheduled cycle successfully post-revert")

## Closure Checks
- Heartbeat service name and configuration documented in operator runbook
- Test alert triggered and received, timestamped in story comment

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Alert window must be shorter than the operator response SLA; recommend ≤2 hours
- User must choose the heartbeat service; Claude cannot access arbitrary external monitoring services

## Escalation Policy
**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

comments.body:
OPERATOR_RUNBOOK: Reconciler heartbeat monitor implemented via GHA scheduled-canary.

## Heartbeat Service
GitHub Actions workflow: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml
Schedule: every hour (0 * * * *) + workflow_dispatch

## Configuration
- Alert window: ALERT_WINDOW_HOURS (default 2h, overridable via workflow_dispatch input)
- Alert mechanism: GitHub Issue with label 'heartbeat-alert' (idempotent — one open alert at a time)
- Self-healing: canary auto-closes the alert issue when reconciler recovers
- Failure visibility: canary job exits non-zero when stale (appears as failed run in GHA UI)

## How to test (simulated disable)
1. Navigate to Actions > Reconciler Heartbeat Canary > Run workflow
2. Set dry_run=false, alert_window_hours=2 (or 0 to force immediate alert)
3. Verify a GitHub Issue with label 'heartbeat-alert' is created (satisfies closure check)
4. After verification, close the issue manually or wait for a successful reconcile-bridge run

## Status
Implementation complete as of commit d3d8560. Test alert pending push to GitHub and first canary dispatch.
